note: Set A contains no claims at all, so it captures none of the title block information on the page. Set B extracts six title-block fields (drawn by, checked by, sheet title, sheet number, lot number, copyright) with values and quotes that match the text layer and the visible title block. No claim in Set B is misbound or invented, so Set B is clearly better despite the page also containing revision history and project credit data that neither set captured.
